description.en: Registers a character handle with the movement manager system (the controller behind CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG/CMND_CHR_TURN_TRG-style scripted movement), returning a handle used to drive its movement. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.
Handle of the character's move-manager entry.

example.code:
// Register a character with the movement manager before scripting its path
local hMove = CMND_CHR_REG_MOVE_MNGR(hChara);
